# SmartLab Learning

> > SmartLab Learning provides project-based STEM education solutions combining career-connected curricula, hands-on tools, customized learning environments, and certified facilitator training for K-12 schools.

SmartLab Learning is a comprehensive STEM education platform offering integrated solutions that include career-centered PBL curricula (Spark, Explorer, Pathfinder, Studio), hands-on equipment kits, customizable learning environments (HQ, FLEX, Studio), professional development for facilitators, and extensive resources for sustainable STEM implementation. The platform serves schools and districts nationwide with proven success in student engagement, problem-solving skills, and career readiness.

## Key Topics

- Project-Based Learning (PBL)
- STEM Education
- Career-Connected Learning

- [SmartLab Learning Homepage](https://www.smartlablearning.com): Project-based STEM solutions for K-12 education

- [Why SmartLab Learning](https://www.smartlablearning.com/why-smartlab): SmartLab value proposition: decision-making, problem-solving, 21st century skills
- [Learning Programs](https://www.smartlablearning.com/learning-programs): SmartLab learning programs: Spark, Explorer, Pathfinder, Studio curricula

## Career-Connected PBL Curricula

- [Career-Centered PBL Curriculum](https://www.smartlablearning.com/what-is-smartlab/career-connected-pbl-curriculum): Career-connected PBL curriculum with Explorer, Pathfinder, Spark programs
- [SmartLab Spark](https://www.smartlablearning.com/what-is-smartlab/career-connected-pbl-curriculum/spark-K12-stem-curriculum): SmartLab Spark K-12 STEM curriculum for self-directed problem-solving projects
- [SmartLab Explorer](https://www.smartlablearning.com/what-is-smartlab/career-connected-pbl-curriculum/explorer-elementary-stem-currriculum): SmartLab Explorer elementary STEM curriculum with career-connected projects
- [SmartLab Pathfinder](https://www.smartlablearning.com/what-is-smartlab/career-connected-pbl-curriculum/pathfinder-middle-school-stem-curriculum): SmartLab Pathfinder middle school STEM curriculum with engineering and robotics
- [SmartLab Studio](https://www.smartlablearning.com/learning-programs/smartlab-studios): SmartLab Studio media production program for video and podcast student projects

## Learning Environments & Tools

- [Customized STEM Learning Environments](https://www.smartlablearning.com/what-is-smartlab/customized-stem-learning-environments): SmartLab HQ, FLEX, and Studio customized STEM learning environment options
